from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A person or entity named in the document involved in the dispute."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the party (e.g., 唐晓梅，穆某军)")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The procedural role (e.g., 复议申请人，上诉人，被执行人)")

class CourtCase(BaseModel):
    """Court and case identifier information found in the document."""
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court mentioned")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case citation number")

class Outcome(BaseModel):
    """The procedural ruling or decision described in the document."""
    action: str | None = Field(description="The main action taken (e.g., 驳回申请，维持原判，撤销裁定)")
    summary: str | None = Field(description="A short summary of the ruling content")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt of the ruling from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties identified in the document")
    case_details: list[CourtCase] = Field(description="List of court and case identifiers")
    outcomes: list[Outcome] = Field(description="List of outcome statements")
